The '''skeleton rangers''' are [[monster]]s fought during the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath]] battle in the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath#Siege phase|siege phase]].

Two of them guard the north-western [[place of power]], and two more the western one. While normally unaggressive, they attack the player when the [[Undead giant (Battle of Forinthry)|undead giant]] at the place of power is engaged and the player is in their range.

In story mode they only defend the place of power. In normal mode they also attack the fort along with [[Skeleton archer (Battle of Forinthry)|skeleton archers]].
